title: Adversarial composed verification and the native comparison
implementation_status: COMPLETE for the adversarial map and the native comparison. One case remains unestablished for an EXTERNAL reason (L10), and a genuine reorg cannot be reproduced on a fork.
accepted_note: Claude authored and ran this. Self-testing is not independent acceptance.
method: This record MAPS each adversarial case P06 requires to the test that actually covers it, rather than asserting coverage. Where nothing covers it, it says NOT COVERED.

summary._note: 'COVERED AT THE CORRECT BOUNDARY' means the V4 contract is tested where V4 actually places the responsibility, not that a mechanism was invented to cover it.

cases.note: resume resends the IDENTICAL body under the IDENTICAL key
C4: an id consumed by a DIFFERENT payload is not success; journal create_or_reopen raises IdentityConflict
the EIP-712 domain commits to the controller address; WrongScope on a foreign scope
BEHAVIOURAL: runner A signs under its retired epoch and the controller reverts WrongEpoch(2,1) / 0x2b9264ec
two concurrent submitters cannot both claim the same operation (UNIQUE PARTIAL INDEX)
the operation is DISPATCHED on disk BEFORE the request leaves the process
a real child process SIGKILLed mid-send leaves a resumable claim; zero duplicate network calls
an ACCEPTED or IN_PROGRESS attempt is polled, never resent

Covered beyond the idempotency window, where a resend requires chain evidence and a zero marker alone must not resend. STILL UNESTABLISHED: a broadcast whose transaction hash is known but whose receipt never arrives on a PUBLIC chain. That needs L10 and does not exist. This is an external blocker, not a testing gap.
a CONFIRMED operation never submits through resume(); the composed run proves it on the fork
a rolled-back apply leaves the machine dirty and needs_execution() refuses; C1 torn-ack record blocks
the exact idempotency-window boundary counts as expired
attempts carry replaces_attempt_id so a replacement never looks like a fresh business operation
without a chain reader there is no verdict at all

cases.status: COVERED AS FAR AS A FORK PERMITS
cases.where: test_handover_machine.py — two P06 GAP tests; sources.py
cases.note: Closed to the limit of the environment. An unfinalized reading is not a verdict where finality is required, finality is established rather than asserted, and an observation that has moved BACKWARD relative to the fence is refused. A genuine chain reorganisation is NOT simulated: an anvil fork has no finality to disagree about. That remains unestablished and is labelled, not claimed.
an adapter stop is not a fence; the controller must stay PAUSED throughout preparation
STALE_CANDIDATE off chain; the contract reverts StaleActivation on chain
garbled logs, truncated module pages, malformed allowances and an unusable fork base all block
an external Morpho delegate blocks the handover and is NOT revoked automatically

V4 deliberately keeps cleanup outside Held's authority: a Morpho grant to another agent may be legitimate use, and revoking it to turn a checklist green would be its own incident. So there is no Held revocation that can fail. What is now tested is the contract at the boundary: the delegate is DETECTED, activation is BLOCKED, the owner must act, a revocation that did not take leaves it STILL blocked, and only a readback showing it gone releases the gate.
R7: missing checkpoints, settled history, a placeholder digest or a wrong active state each set usable=false
C4: a caller-supplied hash that disagrees with the journal is refused; the journal's binding is authoritative
43 decision tests; typed parsing, decoded events, scoped inventories
the credential is a reference and never appears in a repr or log line; console authentication and redaction

native_comparison.headline: Held does not reduce owner work. It ties competent native tooling on the interrupted change and is more expensive on the clean one.
native_comparison.interrupted_change: TIE at 2 ceremonies / 4 signatures; Held submits one more transaction (the Zodiac setAllowance a raised ceiling requires)
held_adds: a refusal the system enforces while an outcome is unknown
an activation-time consistency guard, observed firing as AllowanceDesynchronised
held_costs: one more transaction on a ceiling change
controller, two role memberships, five budgets and a durable journal
a further component to trust and maintain
native_comparison.claims_updated: C1 WITHDRAWN as measured false. C2-C5 recorded at what the measurements actually support.

not_an_audit: Finite adversarial testing is not an audit and is not presented as one.
